```{r, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    collapse = TRUE,
    comment = "#>"
)
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    grid.segments(
        c(0, .5),
        c(.5, 0),
        c(1, .5),
        c(.5, 1),
        gp = gpar(lty = 4, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
    )
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2, fill = NA))
    }
}

setKnitrPresets <- function(
  height = 3, width = 3, error = TRUE, align = "center"
) {
    chunkSet <- knitr::opts_chunk$set
    chunkSet(error = error)
    chunkSet(fig.height = height)
    chunkSet(fig.width = width)
    chunkSet(fig.align = align)
}

setKnitrPresets(4, 4)
```

```{r setup}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

## Vertical Typesetting

```{r vert}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The text is rendered vertically by default.",
    y = .8,
    direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。")
```

## `{ggplot2}` Example

```{r, echo = FALSE}
setKnitrPresets(6, 6)
```
```{r ggp, message = FALSE}
library(gggrid)

label <- function(data, coords) {
    uplatexGrob(
        "このグラフは、自動車の燃費とエンジン排気量との関係を示しています。",
        x = coords$x, y = coords$y,
        hjust = 1, vjust = 1, height = unit(1, "in")
    )
}

gg <- ggplot(mtcars) +
    geom_point(aes(x = disp, y = mpg))

gg +
    labs(
        x = "エンジン排気量 (Engine Displacement)",
        y = "燃費 (Miles per gallon)",
        title = "エンジン排気量と燃費の関係",
        subtitle = "Engine Displacement vs Fuel Economy"
    ) +
    theme(
        axis.title.x = element_uplatex(direction = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_uplatex(),
        plot.title = element_uplatex(direction = 0, family = "serif", fontface = "bold")
    ) +
    grid_panel(
        label,
        data = data.frame(x = max(mtcars$disp), y = max(mtcars$mpg)),
        aes(x, y)
    )
```

## Horizontal Typesetting

```{r horiz}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The \\texttt{direction = 0} parameter typesets text horizontally.",
    gp = gpar(width = unit(2, "in")),
    y = .75, direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", direction = 0)
```

## Basic Math Example

```{r e1}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex("全体の $x_i^z \\frac{1}{2}$ は です。", x = .35)
grid.uplatex("次式は $ax^2 + bx + c$ の形をしています。", x = .65)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
setKnitrPresets(6, 6)
```

## Font Customisation

Font customisation is supported from presets offered by `{pxchfon}` such as the following:

1. `ipa`
1. `ipaex`
1. `haranoaji`
1. `sourcehan`
1. `noto`

Only `plain` and `bold` font faces are supported since Japanese glyphs are already monospaced.

### Font Families

```{r families, fig.align = "center"}
drawGrid()
fontfamilies <- c("sourcehan", "serif", "noto", "ipaex", "haranoaji")
xs <- seq(.1, .9, by = .2)
invisible(mapply(
    \(x, fam, fac) {
        grid.latex(fam, x = x, y = .75)
        grid.uplatex(
            "これはフォントです。",
            x = x,
            gp = gpar(fontfamily = fam)
        )
    },
    xs, fontfamilies
))
```

### Font Faces

```{r faces, fig.align = "center"}
drawGrid()
invisible(mapply(
    \(x, fam, fac) {
        grid.latex(fam, x = x, y = .75)
        grid.uplatex(
            "これはフォントです。",
            x = x,
            gp = gpar(fontfamily = fam, fontface = "bold")
        )
    },
    xs, fontfamilies
))
```

## Regression Checks

```{r reg}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("LuaTeX", engine = "LuaTeX", y = .7)
grid.latex("XeTeX", engine = "XeTeX", y = .3)
```
